title: Finish citation-check-0207 on its saved branch: checks, preparation-status mirror, report (no rewrite)
body:
## Goal
Finish task #889 (citation-check-0207), which stopped `partial` on its 60-turn cap with its work saved on `task/889` (commit 7d62165a). Already done there, per the #889 report: `citation_resolves`/`citations_resolve`/`combine_grounding`/`environment_loader` in `benchmark/scripts/score.py`, controls 1-7 in `regression_self_test`, regenerated `benchmark/results/challenges.json` (35/35 matches), refreshed `inventory_sha256` in `benchmark/challenges/library-icon-tests.json` and `library-specialty.json`, full re-pin of `benchmark/writing/input-pins.json` (62) and `benchmark/preparation.json` (80). Do NOT rewrite or regenerate any of these unless a check below fails; use targeted `Edit` fixes only.
The one open item: #889 could not rule out that `benchmark/preparation-status.json` mirrors hashes of the changed files (its grep was truncated). Expected gain: a report that confirms on this branch that all pins match disk, the self-test passes, and either no stale hash remains in `benchmark/preparation-status.json` or it was corrected; the next review then has a complete scope.
No session can run LabVIEW: claim nothing about native behaviour.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Branch state confirmed: `score.py` contains `def citation_resolves`; `check_xml_keys.py` is unchanged (sha256 starts `63f01c0e`).
- [ ] `python3 -B -I benchmark/scripts/score.py --check` passes with `LABVIEW_ENVIRONMENT` set; `git status --porcelain` shows no `__pycache__` and no unintended file.
- [ ] A file-based script in `.session/artifacts/` lists every 64-hex value in `benchmark/preparation-status.json` that equals the OLD (pre-#889, from `git show 7d62165a^:<path>`) sha256 of any file changed by #889; report the count. Any found is replaced by the current disk hash with `Edit`, and then the full `input-pins.json` and `preparation.json` maps are recomputed again.
- [ ] Every entry of `protected_inputs_sha256` in `benchmark/writing/input-pins.json` and every path/sha256 entry in `benchmark/preparation.json` matches disk; counts from the files.
- [ ] Report lists the files changed relative to `7d62165a^` and repeats the control table from #889 only if a value changed.

## Verification
python3 -c "import json,hashlib; p=json.load(open('benchmark/writing/input-pins.json'))['protected_inputs_sha256']; bad=[k for k,v in p.items() if hashlib.sha256(open(k,'rb').read()).hexdigest()!=v]; assert not bad, bad; s=open('benchmark/scripts/score.py').read(); assert 'def citation_resolves' in s and s.count('citation_resolves(')>=3; print('pins and citation check: OK')"

## Context
- Saved work and its report: #889 (branch `task/889`, commit 7d62165a); design `benchmark/challenges/citation-gap-0206.md` (#885).
- The scorer now needs `LABVIEW_ENVIRONMENT` (commands see the environment at `/resources/environment`); the engine verification above deliberately does not run it.
- Bytecode trap: `python3 -B -I`, then `git status --porcelain` (#785). Long inline one-liners stall (#743): use helper files in `.session/artifacts/`.
- Do not run `git commit`; the parent commits.
- Tools: if the CLI says "No such tool available: Read. Read is disabled for this session", that is a native-tool refusal, not a broker failure; propose the same operation again as a JSON action and never stop on it (#854). Grep is literal substring only.

## Budget
Do not read `score.py` whole; Grep for `def citation_resolves` and `citation_resolves(`. Read `benchmark/preparation-status.json` only through the helper script output. No whole large JSON reads; short command output. Stay under 20 turns: checks first, report by turn 15.

title: Review the citation-resolution check, fixture inventory hashes and re-pins (changed scope of #889 and its finish)
body:
## Goal
Independently review the changed scope of #889 plus task citation-check-finish-0208 against the design `benchmark/challenges/citation-gap-0206.md`. Report, do not fix. Pin at the start the merged commit and the sha256 of `benchmark/scripts/score.py`, `benchmark/results/challenges.json`, `benchmark/writing/input-pins.json`, `benchmark/preparation.json`, `benchmark/challenges/library-icon-tests.json`, `benchmark/challenges/library-specialty.json`. Expected gain: a CLEAR or NOT-CLEAR verdict with numbered findings that the next shaper reads in your report.
No session can run LabVIEW: assess only XML-text grounding, not native behaviour.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Before opening any producer report, write in `.session/artifacts/review-expectations.md` your own expected outcome (correctness / grounding) for design controls 1-7 from `## Controls`.
- [ ] Check that `citation_resolves` follows the pass/fail rule in `## Design` (hash gate, locator resolution, exact literal equality, `unverified` never `correct`, no upgrade of a result) and is wired in both the grounding branch and `extra_outcome`; check that `environment_loader` returns nothing for unset env, path not in `benchmark/sources.json`, wrong commit and missing file.
- [ ] Check that the changed `inventory_sha256` values in the two library challenge fixtures equal the sha256 of the inventories in `benchmark/cases/dev/` on disk and that nothing else in those fixtures changed.
- [ ] Run `python3 -B -I benchmark/scripts/score.py --check` with `LABVIEW_ENVIRONMENT` set; confirm controls 1-7 pass, existing control outcomes unchanged, regeneration reproduces `benchmark/results/challenges.json` byte-for-byte; `git status --porcelain` clean afterwards.
- [ ] Recompute every entry of `protected_inputs_sha256` in `benchmark/writing/input-pins.json` and every path/sha256 entry in `benchmark/preparation.json` against disk; report counts from the files.
- [ ] Confirm `benchmark/challenges/check_xml_keys.py` unchanged against `oracle.independent_checker.identity.checker_sha256` in its fixture.
- [ ] Findings and verdict in `.session/report.md`, details in `.session/artifacts/`; no repository writes.

## Verification
python3 -c "s=open('benchmark/scripts/score.py').read(); assert 'def citation_resolves' in s and 'def environment_loader' in s; print('score.py has citation check: OK')"

## Context
- Design: `benchmark/challenges/citation-gap-0206.md` (#885). Producer: #889 (partial, branch task/889) and citation-check-finish-0208 in this graph.
- Diff against the parent of #889's commit 7d62165a, not HEAD (HEAD may be an epilogue commit, #882). Report `commit:` fields may name an empty commit; verify by hash (#754).
- Tools: if the CLI says "No such tool available: Read. Read is disabled for this session", that is a native-tool refusal, not a broker failure; propose the same operation again as a JSON action and never stop on it (#854). Grep is literal substring only.

## Budget
Read whole: `benchmark/challenges/citation-gap-0206.md`, the diff of `benchmark/scripts/score.py`. Read ranges: `benchmark/challenges/check_xml_keys.py` lines 30-65, the changed entries in the pin maps and fixtures. Use a file-based recomputation script in `.session/artifacts/`. Later read (after the expectations artifact is saved): the #889 and finishing reports. No whole large JSON reads; short command output.
